pending_part_2.description: PART 2 (FINALE): Nine years after D.B. Cooper vanished, bundle serial numbers resurface in the sand. #shorts #viral #mystery
pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we witnessed D.B. Cooper's impossible mid-air parachute jump into the freezing storm. The FBI launched the most exhaustive manhunt in American history, deploying hundreds of soldiers, bloodhounds, and submarines to sweep the Columbia River basin. Not a single trace of Cooper, his parachute, or the money was found for nine years. Then in nineteen eighty, an eight-year-old boy digging on a beach near Vancouver, Washington, unearthed three rotting packets of Cooper's cash totaling five thousand eight hundred dollars, verified by serial numbers. Microscopic algae testing on the bills proved they entered the river months after the jump, miles away from where Cooper allegedly landed. Did Cooper survive the drop and escape under a new identity, or does his skeleton still hang in the dense forest canopy?
